official_source_url.value: https://jordan.gov.jo/EN/Pages/Travel_Visas (Jordan e-government portal, "Jordan Gate") confirms a "passport-sized photo" is required among visa application documents, but does not publish exact dimensions, background colour, or other technical specifications on this page. The Ministry of Interior's e-services portal (moi.gov.jo, Visa E-Applications) was also checked and lists visa categories (Visit/Transit/Exit-Entry/Study/Work) without photo specifications.
